handwrytten.label: Handwrytten (real pen robots, mailed from the US)
handwrytten.pricingNote: Pay-as-you-go retail card price plus flat international stamp and manual-processing surcharge for Canadian addresses. Subscriptions cut the card price by 10 to 20 percent; business plans go as low as USD 1.49 per card. See docs/research/handwritten-notes-providers.md (checked 2026-10-03).

plotter.label: In-house AxiDraw pen plotter (Canada Post stamp)
plotter.pricingNote: A2 card + envelope bought in packs of 50, Canada Post booklet stamp (CAD 1.24 since 2025-01-13), front-desk time to load cards. Hardware (AxiDraw SE/A4 or V3, about USD 550 to 800) is a one-time cost not included per card.
